t: The Body's Blueprint: From Circadian Rhythms to Cosmic Chirality
s: This article explains the human body's fundamental building blocks and energy systems, from cellular nutrition and circadian rhythms to the universal left-handedness (chirality) of life, suggesting extraterrestrial life might also exhibit homochirality.
sub: Circadian rhythms and their impact on body function and productivity.
Essential nutrition: amino acids, vitamins (e.g., Vitamin C), and minerals for bodily repair and function.
Fundamental biomolecules (atoms, amino acids, lipids, sugars) and their organization into complex structures (proteins, DNA, RNA).
Energy metabolism via ATP production in mitochondria and the 'carb debate' concerning refined sugars.
Chirality (handedness) in biomolecules, particularly L-amino acids, and its implications for life's universal asymmetry and potential alien biochemistry.
